channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Um dia após foto com Trump, Flávio encontra Marco Rubio em Washington
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) met with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Vice President JD Vance in Washington, one day after meeting with Donald Trump. The lawmaker posted a photo alongside Rubio on social media.

item.title: Eleições 2026: TSE lança versão digital do Código Eleitoral Anotado e Legislação Complementar
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) released the digital 2026 edition of the Annotated Electoral Code and Complementary Legislation, available for free as a PDF in the TSE’s Publications Catalog and Digital Library. The edition features interactive navigation, a clickable table of contents, advanced text search, offline access, and support for annotations and highlights, aiming to improve access to electoral law for judges, lawyers, prosecutors, political parties, public servants, and citizens during the 2026 election period.

item.title: O ‘fator Eduardo’ que voltou à tona após visita de Flávio Bolsonaro a Trump
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's visit to Donald Trump in the U.S. brought Eduardo Bolsonaro back to the center of internal tensions within bolsonarism, as his behind-the-scenes role in the family's international agenda has caused discomfort within the PL and raised doubts about the independence of Flávio's presidential campaign. Although the Trump meeting was framed as an effort to move past the Banco Master scandal, Eduardo's presence reignited concerns about his excessive influence on strategic decisions, with allies questioning whether he aids or hinders the campaign's reorganization.

item.title: Boulos chama de “fake” apoio do PL à escala 4 X 3
item.description: Guilherme Boulos criticized the PL for proposing a preference highlight on the 4 X 3 workweek PEC, calling it "fake" and asserting it lacked genuine commitment to workers. He noted negotiations were already progressing and expected a 'consecratory' approval in the Chamber and swift action in the Senate, aiming to finalize the bill before the parliamentary recess.

item.title: Senado aprova projeto de incentivo ao primeiro emprego para jovens
item.description: The Senate approved Bill PL 5228/19, establishing a first job contract for youths aged 18 to 29 without formal work experience, featuring reduced FGTS rates (from 8% to 2%-6% based on company size) and a cut in employer social security contributions (from 20% to 10%). The bill now heads to presidential sanction, after the removal of provisions for unemployed workers over 50, as decided by rapporteur Senator Renan Calheiros.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se reúne com Marco Rubio nos EUA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro met with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Washington, accompanied by Eduardo Bolsonaro and journalist Paulo Figueiredo, to discuss economic and political cooperation, as well as the designation of PCC and CV as foreign terrorist organizations. The meeting followed a meeting with Donald Trump at the White House and is seen by allies as a political asset for Flávio’s 2026 presidential pre-campaign. The Lula government is monitoring the trip, with Vice President Geraldo Alckmin publicly criticizing Eduardo Bolsonaro’s foreign activities as harmful to Brazil.

item.title: Itamaraty recomenda evitar viagens a 3 regiões da Bolívia
item.description: The Itamaraty advised against non-essential travel to the Bolivian regions of La Paz, Oruro, and Potosí due to road blockages and protests stemming from the country's political and economic crisis, which are disrupting access to key tourist sites like the Uyuni Salt Flats and Lake Titicaca. The alert, issued on Monday, May 25, 2026, urges Brazilians already in Bolivia to avoid unnecessary movements and maintain frequent contact with family, while exercising heightened vigilance against scams, theft, and robberies. President Lula also authorized humanitarian aid following a call with Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz.

item.title: Governo Lula é desaprovado por 50% e aprovado por 46%, diz pesquisa
item.description: The Indexa Poll, released on May 27, 2026, shows 50% of voters disapprove of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's management, while 46% approve, with 4% undecided. Federal government evaluation indicates 32% rate the administration as 'excellent' or 'good', 25% as 'fair', and 41% as 'poor' or 'terrible'. The survey interviewed 2,000 Brazilian voters from May 22–24, with a 2.2 percentage point margin of error and TSE registration BR-02154/2026.

item.title: Ação no TSE contra cinebiografia de Bolsonaro é censura prévia, acusa Girão
item.description: Senator Eduardo Girão (Novo-CE) criticized a legal action filed by the Prerrogativas lawyers' group and federal deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG) with the TSE, seeking to suspend the screening of the biopic 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro until the end of the 2026 elections, calling it prior censorship. Girão likened the move to the TSE's 2022 ban on certain audiovisual content during campaigns and accused the Lula government of using Internet Civil Marco decrees as a pretext to censor social media, with oversight by the ANPD.

item.title: Nikolas diz que PL quer “escancarar” efeitos da escala 4 X 3
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) stated that the Liberal Party (PL) is advocating for the 4x3 work schedule to highlight the negative economic impacts of the original Psol proposal, which aimed for a 36-hour workweek and three days off. He warned that such a change could raise prices and claimed Brazil would 'break in 1 or 2 months' if implemented without transition. The approved committee text sets a 40-hour workweek with a 5x2 schedule, while the PL also signed an amendment allowing up to 52 hours with a 10-year transition period.

item.title: Alcolumbre promulga trecho da LDO que autoriza repasses a estados e municípios em ano eleitoral
item.description: Congress President Davi Alcolumbre promulgated provisions of the Budget Guidelines Law (LDO) that overturned a presidential veto, allowing donations of goods and funds to states and municipalities during the electoral period — including food baskets, tractors, and ambulances — without violating the electoral blackout period. The measure also releases funding for state and municipal roads, waterways, and agreements with indebted municipalities under 65,000 inhabitants, benefiting over 3,100 cities. Alcolumbre defended the change at the March of Mayors, emphasizing its importance for small and financially distressed municipalities.

item.title: Confira a pauta de julgamentos do TSE desta quinta-feira (28)
item.description: The TSE Plenary will judge nine cases on Thursday (28), including appeals regarding the certification of the mayor and vice-mayor of Salitre (CE) and fines imposed on the elected officials of Baixo Guandu (ES) in the 2024 Municipal Elections. It will also review the homologation of annotations in the statute of the Brazil Hope Federation (FE Brasil). The session will be broadcast live starting at 10 a.m. via Radio and TV Justice and the TSE’s YouTube channel.

item.title: Oposição se divide sobre disposição de Alcolumbre com PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: The opposition is divided on how to obstruct the PEC that would end the 6×1 work schedule, with productive sectors and allies of Flávio Bolsonaro fearing that President Lula could use its approval as a campaign advantage in 2026. Some believe Senate President Davi Alcolumbre may delay the bill due to his rift with Lula and pressure from industry representatives, while others dismiss this possibility given the measure’s popular support and the risk of harming allied candidates in the elections. The opposition’s strategy centers on slowing the PEC’s advancement, but there is disagreement over whether Alcolumbre will actually block or delay it.

item.title: Caiado diz que se encontrará novamente com Zema em meio a articulações sobre unir candidaturas
item.description: Former governors Ronaldo Caiado (PSD-GO) and Romeu Zema (Novo-MG) confirmed they will meet again in early June to discuss a potential presidential alliance for 2026, aiming to unite center-right candidacies as an alternative to Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Both acknowledge that Lula and Flávio still lead in polls, with the latest Datafolha showing Lula at 40%, Flávio at 31%, Caiado at 4%, and Zema at 3%. The articulation causes internal discomfort within the PSD, though allies downplay the crisis.

item.title: Justiça suspende projeto da ‘Times Square paulistana’ de Tarcísio e Nunes
item.description: São Paulo's judiciary has suspended the 'Times Square paulistana' project, which aimed to install LED panels at the intersection of São João and Ipiranga avenues in the city center. Judge Celina Kiyomi Toyoshima of the 4th Public Finance Court annulled the project's approval by the Urban Landscape Protection Commission and banned any construction, citing threats to the integrity of the Cidade Limpa Law and insufficient public debate. The initiative, announced by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Mayor Ricardo Nunes in April, was challenged via popular action for prioritizing private economic interests over collective urban and environmental interests.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se encontra com vice de Trump e secretário de Estado dos EUA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, a senator and pre-candidate for the Brazilian presidency, said he met in Washington with U.S. Vice President J.D. Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio to discuss the potential designation of Brazil’s PCC and CV criminal factions as foreign terrorist organizations by the United States. He claimed both officials were supportive, but alleged the move has been stalled due to pressure from President Lula’s government. He also confirmed a meeting with Donald Trump on Tuesday, where he made the same request.

item.title: Governador de MG aprova ideia de aliança entre Zema e Caiado
item.description: Minas Gerais Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) expressed support for a potential alliance between presidential pre-candidates Romeu Zema (Novo) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), stating he views the idea favorably. The comment was made in an interview released on May 27, 2026, at 6:00 PM.

item.title: PSD contém início de rebelião após ala bolsonarista defender Zema como vice de Caiado
item.description: The PSD is facing an internal rebellion after its Bolsonarist faction advocated for former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) to be the vice-presidential candidate on a ticket with Ronaldo Caiado (União Brasil). Party leaders argue it is unacceptable for the vice-presidential spot to go to someone without historical ties to the PSD, emphasizing the need to uphold the party’s founding principles and leadership. PSD congressional leader Antônio Brito acknowledged the discomfort but said the issue has been resolved.

item.title: Ibovespa fecha em baixa após inflação acima do esperado
item.description: The Ibovespa closed lower at 175,947 points as higher-than-expected inflation (IPCA-15 up 0.62% in May) and Middle East tensions kept investors cautious, with the dollar staying above 5 reais. Despite external uncertainty, major banks posted gains, led by Bradesco (+1.29%).

item.title: Os 4 deputados que votaram contra o fim da escala 6×1 em comissão da Câmara
item.description: The Chamber's special committee approved, by a vote of 34 to 4, a PEC to reduce the workweek from 44 to 40 hours in two stages. The only opposing votes came from deputies Gilson Marques (Novo-SC), Julia Zanatta (PL-SC), Mauricio Marcon (PL-RS) and Osmar Terra (PL-RS). The proposal now moves to the plenary floor, where at least 308 votes in two rounds are required to advance to the Senate.

item.title: Para Oriovisto, propostas como mudança na escala 6x1 são 'irresponsáveis'
item.description: Senator Oriovisto Guimarães (PSDB-PR) criticized the federal government's economic and social policies as electoral and fiscally unsustainable, particularly the expansion of benefits such as Bolsa Família, Auxílio Gás, and the Desenrola Brasil program. He also opposed the proposal to reduce the workweek from 6x1 to 5x2 without salary reduction, arguing it would increase labor costs without productivity gains, calling it irresponsible.

item.title: Comissão especial aprova relatório da PEC do fim da escala 6×1; texto segue ao plenário
item.description: The special committee of the Chamber approved the report of PEC 221/19, which reduces the workweek from 44 to 40 hours in two phases, with two paid weekly rest days and no salary reduction. With 34 votes in favor and 4 against, the text now proceeds to the plenary, where voting is expected this Wednesday or Thursday, with an agreement between the Chamber presidency and the Lula government to approve it unchanged.

item.title: Trump elogiou Lula durante reunião com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: During a meeting at the White House, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) met with Donald Trump and urged him to designate Brazil’s PCC and Comando Vermelho as foreign terrorist organizations. Trump praised President Lula for his dynamism, repeating public compliments he had made before, and said he would consider the request. Flávio also discussed public security, tariffs, and rare earth minerals with Trump.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro pediu envio do 'máximo possível' de recursos para 'Dark Horse', diz site
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro instructed an intermediary to send the maximum possible resources to the United States to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about the trajectory of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The messages were disclosed by The Intercept Brasil on Wednesday (27). The content suggests possible campaign financing practices through foreign channels.

item.title: Os próximos passos do julgamento da revisão criminal de Bolsonaro no STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques has granted the Attorney General's Office 20 days to submit an opinion on Bolsonaro's criminal revision request, filed on May 8 to overturn his 27-year-and-3-month sentence. The defense claims 'judicial error,' but legal experts note low chances of success, as the Court has already validated the conviction. The plenary is expected to uphold the decision, with no further appeal possible after the final ruling.

item.title: Governo emite alerta e recomenda a brasileiros que evitem viagens à Bolívia em meio à crise no país
item.description: The Brazilian Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a consular advisory urging Brazilians to avoid travel to Bolivia due to road blockages in La Paz, Oruro, and Potosí, driven by protests demanding agrarian policy changes, fuel quality improvements, and the resignation of President Rodrigo Paz. The Itamaraty warns the situation is dynamic and may spread, disrupting access to destinations like the Salar de Uyuni and making overland travel difficult, with some exits now only possible by air. Brazil also sent humanitarian aid at Paz’s request, including an aircraft loan and non-perishable food, while Lula emphasized the importance of democratic institutions and the rule of law.

item.title: Lula tem 46% de aprovação e 50% de desaprovação, aponta pesquisa Indexa
item.description: Lula has 46% approval and 50% disapproval according to the Indexa poll from May 2026, with disapproval leading in the South, Central-West, and North regions, while the Southeast and Northeast show a technical tie. He retains strong support among his 2022 voters (80% approval) and faces high rejection among Bolsonaro voters (83% disapproval), yet still competes for moderate voters (49% approve, 44% disapprove). Despite his overall disadvantage, Lula remains competitive in potential runoff scenarios, suggesting the opposition has not yet consolidated a candidate capable of fully capitalizing on his government's wear.

item.title: Comissão aprova relatório de PEC que acaba com escala 6X1
item.description: The special committee of the Chamber of Deputies approved the report of PEC 221/19, which proposes reducing the workweek from 44 to 40 hours with two days off and no salary reduction, ending the 6x1 scale. The text was approved by 34 votes in favor and four against and now proceeds to a two-round vote in the plenary, where it needs at least 308 votes to pass.

item.title: Flávio se reúne com vice-secretário de Estado dos EUA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) participated in a meeting at the U.S. Department of State in Washington with Deputy Secretary Christopher Landau and presidential advisor Darren Beattie, accompanied by former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro and journalist Paulo Figueiredo. The meeting took place one day after the publication of a related article in O Antagonista. The engagement highlights the Bolsonaro family’s outreach to U.S. officials on foreign policy matters.

item.title: Lula assina pacote de R$ 8,2 bi para o Amazonas
item.description: President Lula’s government announced an R$ 8.2 billion investment package for Amazonas, targeting road infrastructure, rural electrification, energy modernization, naval industry, and sustainable development. Key allocations include R$ 381.4 million for BR-319 upgrades, R$ 3.3 billion for energy security (including Luz Para Todos and grid modernization), R$ 1.2 billion for 128 barges and 3 pushers via the Merchant Marine Fund, and R$ 876 million for the Manaus Moderna Hydroviary Terminal. Transport Minister George Santoro said the entire BR-319 will be under construction by June, and Lula claimed it will be 'environmentally, the most modern road in the world'.

item.title: O desabafo de deputada do PL sobre ‘estratégia’ de apoio à escala 4×3: ‘Virou um circo’
item.description: Federal deputy Julia Zanatta (PL-SC) criticized the PL party leader Sóstenes Cavalcante's strategy of supporting the 4×3 work scale to pressure the Lula government, calling the debate a 'circus' and lamenting the lack of seriousness in Brazilian politics. She reaffirmed her support for the 6×1 scale, arguing that reducing the workweek would increase labor costs and harm workers, while labeling the proposal as electoralist and cheap populism. Zanatta also said she was booed and threatened by workers during special committee sessions.

item.title: Senado aprova a Lei Geral da Copa do Mundo Feminina; Brasil sediará evento em 2027
item.description: The Senate approved the General Law for the Women's World Cup, establishing rules for hosting the tournament in Brazil in 2027, including responsibilities of the Union, FIFA, and involved entities. The text provides for temporary visas for credentialed individuals, a specific time bank for workers, national security coordination by the Federal Police, and no obligation for FIFA to offer ticket discounts or free admissions. The bill now proceeds to presidential sanction.

item.title: Comissão especial rejeita destaque do PL e conclui aprovação de PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: The special committee approved the PEC reducing the workweek from 44 to 40 hours without salary cuts, with a 14-month transition and staggered reduction of two hours after 60 days and another two after 12 months. The PL attempted to block immediate implementation via a highlight, but it was rejected in a symbolic vote. The proposal, a priority of President Lula, received support from part of the opposition and was attended by Ministers José Guimarães and Luiz Marinho.

item.title: Lula: falta pouco para anúncio sobre petróleo na Margem Equatorial
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said there is little time left for Petrobras to announce whether the Equatorial Margin holds the estimated oil or gas reserves, praising the company's expertise in deep-water exploration and the region's potential to become a new pre-salt province with at least 30 billion barrels estimated. He also announced that Petrobras will resume exploration in previously abandoned areas, including the Urucu field in the Solimões Basin, where 18 new wells will be drilled to seek additional production.

item.title: Comissão especial aprova texto-base da PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: The special committee approved the base text of the PEC to reduce the workweek from 44 to 40 hours without salary cuts, with a 14-month transition period. The vote received support from the government base and part of the opposition despite clashes, while only four deputies voted against. The PL introduced a highlight aiming to overturn the staggered implementation, proposing immediate changes after promulgation.

item.title: Crusoé: Zema vice de Michelle?
item.description: A faction of the Novo party is urging the PL to replace Flávio Bolsonaro with Michelle Bolsonaro as the presidential candidate, arguing he can no longer defeat Lula in a runoff following leaked audio in which he asks a banker for money. The proposal also suggests Zema as a potential vice-presidential running mate on Michelle's ticket.

item.title: Relator do pedido para anular condenação de Bolsonaro, Nunes Marques tem rejeitado revisões de condenados do 8 de janeiro
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques, rapporteur of the request to annul Jair Bolsonaro's conviction, has followed the STF majority in rejecting criminal revisions of those convicted for the January 8 attacks, arguing there are no new elements to reopen the cases. He has voted with the majority in four of the five cases analyzed, including upholding the conviction for damage to protected heritage. Although he initially upheld Bolsonaro's conviction, after a request for vista, he changed his vote to align with Minister Luiz Fux's dissent, which supports revising convictions for serious crimes such as coup and violent abolition of the democratic state.

item.title: Comissão aprova PEC pelo fim da escala 6×1; plenário vota nesta quarta
item.description: The special committee of the Chamber of Deputies approved the report of the PEC that ends the 6x1 work scale and reduces the weekly workload from 44 to 40 hours without salary cuts, implemented in two stages over 14 months after promulgation. The report, authored by Deputy Léo Prates (Republicanos-BA), now moves to the plenary, where it needs at least 308 votes in two rounds to proceed to the Senate. The proposal resulted from an agreement between President Lula and Chamber President Hugo Motta, following negotiations with the productive sector on the transition timeline.

item.title: Comissão da Câmara aprova proposta que estabelece o fim da escala 6x1 e texto vai ao plenário
item.description: The special committee of the Chamber of Deputies approved the PEC reducing the workweek from 44 to 40 hours, granting two weekly days off, one preferably on Sundays, after a one-year transition. The vote was 34 in favor and 4 against. The proposal will now go to the plenary floor today, requiring 308 of 513 deputies for approval in two rounds, with Chamber President Hugo Motta indicating it may be voted on today.

item.title: Novo vê risco para alianças com PL nos estados e cobra ‘moderação’ de Zema em críticas a Flávio
item.description: Allies of presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) urged moderation in his criticisms of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), fearing that aggressive rhetoric could harm alliances with the PL in states and limit the party's congressional growth. Tensions rose after Zema labeled Flávio’s alleged dealings with Master Bank as 'imperdoable' and 'a slap in the face of Brazilians,' causing discomfort within Novo’s conservative wing. Although Zema later released a more tempered video stating his absolute priority is removing the PT from power, Novo leaders warn that escalating attacks on Flávio may backfire electorally.

item.title: Sem definir quem seria o cabeça de chapa, Caiado e Zema falam na possibilidade de unir candidaturas
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) and Romeu Zema (Novo) discussed the possibility of uniting their pre-candidacies for the 2026 presidential election following a meeting in São Paulo. Both acknowledge that Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro lead in the polls and argue that their alliance would only become competitive in a potential runoff or with significant growth in voter support. No agreement has been reached on who would lead the ticket, with allies of each suggesting the other as vice-president, but both stress that a decision should wait for the electoral landscape to mature.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro discute com Departamento de Estado dos EUA classificar PCC e CV como terroristas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president from the opposition, met with the U.S. Department of State to discuss classifying Brazil's PCC and CV criminal factions as foreign terrorist organizations. The meeting included Deputy Secretary Christopher Landau and senior policy advisor Darren Beattie, alongside allies Paulo Figueiredo and Eduardo Bolsonaro. Flávio stated that, if elected, he would support the designation and lead Brazil to join Trump's 'Shield of the Americas' coalition to combat drug trafficking.

item.title: Kassio pede que PGR se manifeste em até 20 dias sobre revisão criminal de Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the Attorney General's Office to respond within 20 days regarding the criminal revision request for former President Jair Bolsonaro's conviction. The decision comes amid legal debates over the validity of the sentence imposed on the ex-president.

item.title: PL e Republicanos negociam chapa em Minas em meio à articulação por Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: PL and Republicanos are negotiating a slate in Minas Gerais for 2026, with the PL seeking to support Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-candidacy. Talks involve figures such as Cleitinho (Republicanos) and Flávio Roscoe (PL), including vice-presidential offers in both scenarios, aiming to preserve the state-level alliance regardless of the final ticket composition.

item.title: Lula tem 58% e Flávio, 30%, no 2º turno na PB, diz pesquisa
item.description: The Real Time Big Data poll shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading voting intentions in Paraíba for the 2026 presidential elections, with 53% in the first round and 58% in the second. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) ranks second, with 24% in the first round and 30% in the second. Other candidates collectively received less than 5% support.

item.title: O presente que Flávio Bolsonaro não conseguiu entregar a Trump
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attempted to present a Brazilian national team jersey to Donald Trump during a White House meeting but was blocked by Secret Service security protocols. The meeting, held in the Oval Office, focused on the potential designation of Brazil's PCC and CV as terrorist organizations by the U.S., as well as Trump's inquiry into Jair Bolsonaro's health and house arrest. Flávio sought to bolster his 2026 presidential candidacy amid controversy over Daniel Vorcaro and Banco Master.

item.title: ONS terá operação especial para evitar apagões em jogos da Copa
item.description: The National Electric System Operator (ONS) has launched a special operation in the National Interconnected System (SIN) to prevent power outages during Brazil's matches in the 2026 World Cup, banning interventions that could cause load shedding nationwide except for urgent maintenance, from two hours before to two hours after each game on June 11, 13, 19, and 24. Continuous weather monitoring is also in place to anticipate storms and atmospheric discharges, with measures extendable if Brazil advances in the tournament.

item.title: PL vê palanque de Flávio Bolsonaro ruir no Rio após operações contra Cláudio Castro
item.description: Federal Police investigations into former Rio governor Cláudio Castro (PL) over the Banco Master and Rioprevidência funds are weakening the Bolsonaro-aligned political base in the state, prompting the PL to consider Senate alternatives like Sóstenes Cavalcante and Carlos Jordy. The scandal also threatens Douglas Ruas’ gubernatorial bid, as his 'continuity' narrative with Castro is being exploited by opponents, especially Eduardo Paes’ allies.

item.title: Justiça eleitoral oficializa expulsão de Aldo Rebelo do Democracia Cristã
item.description: The Electoral Justice officially expelled Aldo Rebelo from the Christian Democracy party after the national leadership replaced him as presidential pre-candidate with Joaquim Barbosa. Rebelo challenged the expulsion in court, arguing it violated the party’s statute and vowed to maintain his candidacy until the party convention, even if requiring judicial intervention. The internal conflict escalated after Rebelo criticized the leadership for allegedly being concerned about the Master case in Alagoas, involving the party president’s son.

item.title: Oposição tentará constranger governo e Centrão em votação da PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: The opposition, led by the PL, plans to use a preference highlight in the vote on the PEC to end the 6×1 work schedule to force the government and the Centrão to vote against a more radical proposal — a 36-hour weekly workweek (4×3) advocated by Deputy Erika Hilton. The goal is to expose inconsistencies in the allied base, which claims to support reduced working hours but may be pressured to reject a greater advancement, damaging their image with voters.
